text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up for the new year, on the way back 
from grocery shopping with Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaah!? Those hot springs are...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look! Over there!! That's the inn featured 
in "The Drifting Hunt"!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That place is so cool and classy! You won 
a stay at THAT ryokan as the grand prize!? 
Whoa, that's insane...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems this is a spot featured in 
Kiseki's favorite manga. Would this be 
what they call a "holy pilgrimage"?
choice_data_list: Alright! Let's aim for the grand prize!
Alright! Aim for the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull out the raffle ticket that came 
with the purchase I just made.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...!? Everything's been entrusted... 
to me...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Seize your destiny." —That's what you 
mean, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Kiseki gathered her courage and 
turned the handle of the raffle wheel!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………――My heart remains unclouded――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, when are we going? What's your 
schedule look like, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if you don't understand 
the material! We have infinite time to 
study ahead!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring all the volumes from home for 
now. When is a good time to ring your 
doorbell?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel a mysterious pressure radiating 
from Kiseki. It seems this decision is 
unavoidable.
choice_data_list:
For now, let me think about a few 
things...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Kiseki went out of her way 
to deliver two paper bags full of manga to 
my room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While adjusting Kiseki's schedule, I might 
as well finish reading this manga...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, so close! Just one spot higher and 
we would've had it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-san, go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you live alone, right, Trainer-san? 
Isn't cooking every day tough on you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
People say "all you have to do is chop and 
fry"... but you still have to buy 
ingredients for the menu, and wash the 
knife and frying pan you used.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you just pop it in the microwave, all 
you have to do is plate it, right? Super 
easy.
choice_data_list: You know surprisingly a lot about cooking.

You know surprisingly a lot about cooking, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I can! There are tons of 
recipes printed in the back of cooking 
manga, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's really delicious when you 
recreate it! It was supervised by a 
culinary researcher, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Shall I lend you a recent recommendation 
of mine? The story gets pretty intense!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, overpowered by Kiseki's 
overwhelming passion, I decided to buy a 
volume of cooking manga to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waha, amazing! It's truly a full box!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That might actually help. Carrots are a 
creator's best friend, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Crunching on them makes it easier to 
focus on my work!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should share some with my 
roommate. She tends to get into the zone a 
lot, too...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, our dorm's board game master might 
love this too! I'll go bring some over to 
Loves-chan and the others while I'm at it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out Kiseki's circle of friends is 
far wider than it appears on the surface. 
That entire box of carrots was reportedly 
handed out and devoured in the blink of an 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aww, no grand prize?! Just a single carrot 
is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hah—?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I have an idea. A story about a 
carrot-shaped automata and the 
protagonist...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The year is XXXX. A time when automata 
exceed 70% of the population. In a back 
alley, the protagonist discovers a giant 
charred carrot.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
According to the Road Cleansing Act, one 
should summon a waste disposal robot. And 
so, the protagonist filed a report, but—

text_block_list.name: Carrot-Shaped Automaton
text_block_list.text:
—"Voiceprint authenticated. Matches C-01's 
'Creator.'"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a giant carrot began to glow! On 
top of that, it started calling itself an 
automaton!! Just what in the world is this 
robot—!?
choice_data_list:
Things have taken an outrageous turn, 
haven't they!?

Things have taken an outrageous turn, 
haven't they!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go polish it a bit more. If it's 
sci-fi, I gotta nail down the 
worldbuilding!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kiseki turned even a single carrot 
into the seed of an idea.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ghh~~...! I couldn't land a hit, huh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Trainer-san, just one more time! 
Can't we do it just one more time!? If I 
just pull one more time—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', the very 
last one has been drawn~~! With this, the 
Grand Prizes are officially all gooone!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the rematch was not to be. 
Kiseki's trip vanished like morning dew...
